title: Non-Fungible Token Support
key_points: Proposes extensions to support native non-fungible tokens on XRP Ledger
Introduces new objects and ledger structures: NFToken, NFTokenOffer, NFTokenPage
NFTs are indivisible, unique, and not used for payments
limitations: Requires an amendment to the XRP Ledger protocol
New transaction types require client library implementation
asserts: This proposal introduces extensions to support a native non-fungible token type with operations to enumerate, purchase, sell and hold such tokens on the XRP Ledger.
